question: A frugal man does not like to spend money without reasons. (Make it Simple)

options.a: A man who is frugal does not like to spend money.
options.b: A frugal man dislikes spending money without reasons.
options.c: Being frugal, a man does not like to spend money for no reason.
options.d: A man is frugal and does not like to spend money.

explanation: আমরা জানি Simple sentence-এ একটি মাত্র Finite Verb থাকে। মূল বাক্যে 'does not like' ভার্বটি আছে। অপশন (b)-তে 'dislikes' ব্যবহার করে বাক্যটিকে একটি মাত্র ক্লজে রাখা হয়েছে যা সঠিক সিম্পল স্ট্রাকচার।

question: The target of a frugal man is to save money for future. (Make it Complex)

options.a: The target of a man who is frugal is to save money for future.
options.b: A man is frugal and his target is to save money.
options.c: Saving money is the target of a frugal man.
options.d: If a man is frugal, he saves money for future.

explanation: Complex sentence করতে হলে একটি Subordinate clause প্রয়োজন। এখানে 'frugal man' (Adjective + Noun) অংশটিকে ভেঙে 'a man who is frugal' করার মাধ্যমে একটি Relative clause তৈরি করা হয়েছে।

question: Everyone should practice frugality to make a well-planned family. (Make it Passive)

options.a: Frugality should practice by everyone.
options.b: A well-planned family should be made by practicing frugality.
options.c: Frugality should be practiced to make a well-planned family.
options.d: Everyone is suggested to practice frugality.

explanation: Modal verb (should) যুক্ত Active sentence-কে Passive করতে হলে: Object (Frugality) + Modal + be + V3 (practiced) বসে। উল্লেখ্য যে, everyone/people থাকলে 'by everyone' না লিখলেও চলে।

question: A frugal man lives a solvent life. (Make it Negative)

options.a: A frugal man does not live a solvent life.
options.b: A frugal man does not live a poor life.
options.c: A frugal man lives a life which is not solvent.
options.d: No frugal man lives a solvent life.

explanation: Affirmative থেকে Negative করার সময় অর্থের পরিবর্তন করা যাবে না। তাই Verb-এর পর not বসিয়ে মূল শব্দের বিপরীত শব্দ (Solvent-এর বিপরীত Poor) ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: A frugal man is happier than a prodigal man. (Make it Positive)

options.a: A prodigal man is as happy as a frugal man.
options.b: A prodigal man is not so happy as a frugal man.
options.c: No other man is as happy as a frugal man.
options.d: A frugal man is very happy.

explanation: Comparative degree-টি Affirmative হলে Positive করার সময় বাক্যটি Negative হয়। নিয়ম: Subject (2nd) + verb + not + so/as + adj (positive) + as + Subject (1st)।

question: He was one of the greatest saints of Islam. (Make it Positive)

options.a: No other saint of Islam was as great as he.
options.b: Very few saints of Islam were as great as he.
options.c: He was as great as other saints of Islam.
options.d: Some saints were as great as he.

explanation: Superlative ডিগ্রিতে 'one of the' থাকলে Positive শুরু হয় 'Very few' দিয়ে। এরপর plural noun (saints) বসে এবং Verb-ও plural (were) হয়।

question: At that time his mother asked him for a glass of water. (Make it Passive)

options.a: At that time he was asked for a glass of water by his mother.
options.b: A glass of water was asked by his mother.
options.c: He had been asked for a glass of water by his mother.
options.d: His mother was asked for a glass of water by him.

explanation: Past Indefinite টেন্সে Passive করতে auxiliary verb 'was/were' বসে। এখানে 'him' অবজেক্টটি সাবজেক্ট 'he' হয়ে সামনে এসেছে।

question: There was no drinking water in the house, so he went out to fetch it. (Make it Complex)

options.a: He went out to fetch water because there was no drinking water.
options.b: As there was no drinking water in the house, he went out to fetch it.
options.c: There being no drinking water in the house, he went out.
options.d: He went out so that he could fetch water.

explanation: কারণ বোঝালে Complex করার সময় 'As/Since/Because' ব্যবহার করা হয়। এখানে 'so' উঠে গিয়ে বাক্যের শুরুতে 'As' বসানো হয়েছে।

question: When he came back, he found his mother sleeping. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He came back and found his mother sleeping.
options.b: Coming back, he found his mother sleeping.
options.c: He found his mother sleeping when he came back.
options.d: He came back so he found his mother sleeping.

explanation: সময় নির্দেশক 'When' যুক্ত Complex sentence-কে Compound করতে 'and' ব্যবহার করা হয়। দুটি ক্লজই স্বাধীনভাবে বসে।

question: He showed a great love and respect to his mother. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: How love and respect he showed to his mother!
options.b: What a great love and respect he showed to his mother!
options.c: What love and respect he showed to his mother!
options.d: How great his love was!

explanation: Assertive বাক্যে a/an না থাকলে 'How' দিয়ে শুরু হয়, কিন্তু এখানে 'love and respect' নাউন হিসেবে থাকায় 'What' দিয়ে শুরু করা সঠিক। তবে 'a' বসবে না কারণ এগুলো Uncountable noun।

question: Tell me your age. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Tell me what your age is.
options.b: Tell me how old are you.
options.c: Tell me when you were born.
options.d: What is your age, tell me.

explanation: Simple থেকে Complex করার সময় অবজেক্ট 'your age' কে একটি নাউন ক্লজ 'what your age is' এ রূপান্তর করা হয়েছে।

question: Some poets are at least as great as Tennyson. (Make it Superlative)

options.a: Tennyson is the greatest of all poets.
options.b: Tennyson is not the greatest of all poets.
options.c: Tennyson is not the only great poet.
options.d: Tennyson is one of the greatest poets.

explanation: Positive বাক্যে 'at least as...as' থাকলে Superlative করার সময় 'not the greatest' স্ট্রাকচারটি ফলো করতে হয়। এর অর্থ হলো টেনিসনই একমাত্র সেরা নন, আরও কেউ তার সমান হতে পারে।

question: What though the field be lost! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It does not matter if the field be lost.
options.b: The field is lost anyway.
options.c: We do not care for the field.
options.d: It is a pity that the field is lost.

explanation: একাধিক বোর্ডের প্রশ্ন। 'What though...!' থাকলে Assertive করার সময় 'It does not matter though/if...' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: My watch was lost. (Make it Active)

options.a: I lost my watch.
options.b: Someone lost my watch.
options.c: My watch lost itself.
options.d: I have lost my watch.

explanation: Passive বাক্যে agent বা কর্তা না থাকলে context অনুযায়ী 'I' বা 'Someone' আনতে হয়। ঘড়ি নিজেরটা নিজে হারানোয় 'I' সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে বেশি যুক্তিযুক্ত।

question: He confessed that he was guilty. (Make it Simple)

options.a: He confessed his guilt.
options.b: Confessing his guilt, he was sorry.
options.c: Being guilty, he confessed.
options.d: He was guilty and confessed it.

explanation: Complex থেকে Simple করতে 'that' ক্লজটিকে নাউন ফ্রেজে পরিণত করতে হয়। 'that he was guilty' এর পরিবর্তে 'his guilt' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

question: Tea is the most popular drink. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: Tea is more popular than any other drink.
options.b: Tea is more popular than most other drinks.
options.c: Tea is as popular as any other drink.
options.d: No other drink is as popular as tea.

explanation: Superlative-এ শুধু 'the' থাকলে Comparative-এ 'than any other' বসে।

question: Tea helps us remove our fatigue. (Make it Passive)

options.a: We are helped by tea to remove our fatigue.
options.b: Fatigue is removed by tea.
options.c: We are helped to remove our fatigue by tea.
options.d: Both a and c are correct.

explanation: এখানে object 'us' সাবজেক্ট হয়ে 'we' হবে। প্রেজেন্ট ইনডিফিনিট টেন্সে auxiliary verb 'are' বসবে। অতিরিক্ত অংশ 'to remove...' ভার্বের পরেও বসতে পারে আবার 'by tea' এর আগেও বসতে পারে।

question: Almost everyone enjoys tea. (Make it Negative)

options.a: There is no one who does not enjoy tea.
options.b: Everyone does not enjoy tea.
options.c: There is hardly anyone who does not enjoy tea.
options.d: Hardly anyone enjoys tea.

explanation: বাক্যে 'Almost everyone' থাকলে Negative করার সময় 'There is hardly anyone... not' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

question: Bangladesh is one of the tea producing countries. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Bangladesh produces tea and it is one of the countries.
options.b: There are tea producing countries and Bangladesh is one of them.
options.c: Bangladesh is a country and it produces tea.
options.d: Bangladesh is a tea producing country.

explanation: Compound বাক্যে দুটি স্বাধীন ক্লজ থাকে যা 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়। 'One of the' থাকলে এই প্যাটার্নটি অর্থ বজায় রাখে।

question: Bangladesh exports tea and earns a lot of foreign exchange. (Make it Simple)

options.a: By exporting tea, Bangladesh earns a lot of foreign exchange.
options.b: Bangladesh exports tea to earn foreign exchange.
options.c: Exporting tea, Bangladesh earns foreign exchange.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Compound থেকে Simple করার সময় 'and' উঠে গিয়ে প্রথম ভার্বের সাথে ing যুক্ত করে বা 'By + ing' অথবা 'to + verb' ব্যবহার করে বাক্যটি গঠন করা যায়।

question: Beautiful! Isn't she? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: She is very beautiful.
options.b: She was beautiful.
options.c: Is she beautiful?
options.d: She is not beautiful.

explanation: Exclamatory বা Interrogative ট্যাগ স্টাইল থাকলে Assertive করার সময় সাবজেক্ট ও ভার্ব আগে এনে 'very' যোগ করতে হয়।

question: Tania nodded in agreement, but she was extremely nervous. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Though Tania nodded in agreement, she was extremely nervous.
options.b: As Tania nodded in agreement, she was nervous.
options.c: If Tania nodded, she would be nervous.
options.d: Tania was nervous because she nodded.

explanation: Compound বাক্যে 'but' থাকলে বিপরীত অর্থ বোঝায়, যা Complex করার সময় 'Though/Although' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: The tigress was now quite close to them. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Wasn't the tigress now quite close to them?
options.b: Was the tigress now quite close to them?
options.c: The tigress was not close, was she?
options.d: How close the tigress was?

explanation: Assertive sentence-টি Affirmative হলে Interrogative করার সময় negative-interrogative (Wasn't) করতে হয়।

question: He got closer to the animal and pressed the shutter button. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Getting closer to the animal, he pressed the shutter button.
options.b: He pressed the shutter button to get closer.
options.c: He got closer to press the button.
options.d: He was getting closer and pressed the button.

explanation: একই সাবজেক্ট দুটি কাজ পরপর করলে প্রথম ভার্বের সাথে ing যোগ করে Simple করতে হয় (Present Participle)।

question: Her husband was the strongest man she had ever met. (Use positive degree)

options.a: No other man she had ever met was as strong as her husband.
options.b: Her husband was as strong as any other man.
options.c: Very few men were as strong as her husband.
options.d: She never met a strong man like her husband.

explanation: Superlative-এ 'the + superlative' থাকলে Positive করার নিয়ম: No other + noun (men) + extension + verb + as/so + positive adj + as + subject।

question: Anger is nothing but a vice. (Make it Affirmative)

options.a: Anger is only a vice.
options.b: Anger is always a vice.
options.c: Anger is a serious vice.
options.d: Is anger a vice?

explanation: Negative বাক্যে 'nothing but' থাকলে Affirmative করার সময় বস্তু বা গুণের ক্ষেত্রে 'only' বসে।

question: It begets only the worst. (Make it Negative)

options.a: It begets nothing but the worst.
options.b: It does not beget the worst.
options.c: It begets not only the worst.
options.d: None but the worst it begets.

explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'only' থাকলে এবং তা কোনো বস্তুকে নির্দেশ করলে নেগেটিভ করতে 'nothing but' বসে।

question: Anger is one of the most inhuman vices. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Very few vices are as inhuman as anger.
options.b: No other vice is as inhuman as anger.
options.c: Anger is as inhuman as other vices.
options.d: Some vices are inhuman like anger.

explanation: Superlative বাক্যে 'one of the' থাকলে Positive-এ 'Very few' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: So, we should control it for our own sake. (Make it Passive)

options.a: So, it should be controlled by us for our own sake.
options.b: So, it should control by us.
options.c: So, we are to control it.
options.d: So, our own sake should be controlled.

explanation: Modal (should) থাকলে passive-এ 'should be + V3' বসে। এখানে 'it' অবজেক্টটি সাবজেক্ট হয়েছে।

question: He who is taken by anger causes a lot of troubles. (Make it Simple)

options.a: An angry man causes a lot of troubles.
options.b: Being taken by anger, he causes troubles.
options.c: A man taken by anger causes a lot of troubles.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Complex থেকে Simple করার সময় Relative clause (He who is...) অংশটিকে Adjective (An angry man) বা Participle phrase (A man taken by...) দ্বারা প্রতিস্থাপন করা যায়।

question: Realizing it, we should try to be emotionally balanced. (Make it Complex)

options.a: When we realize it, we should try to be emotionally balanced.
options.b: If we realize it, we should try to be balanced.
options.c: As we realize it, we should try to be balanced.
options.d: Both a and c are correct.

explanation: Present participle (Realizing) যুক্ত Simple বাক্য সময় বা কারণ বোঝালে Complex-এ 'When' অথবা 'As/Since' দিয়ে শুরু করা যায়।

question: An honest man is honoured everywhere by all. (Make it Active)

options.a: All honour an honest man everywhere.
options.b: Everywhere all honours an honest man.
options.c: People honour an honest man.
options.d: All will honour an honest man.

explanation: Passive-এ 'by all' থাকায় Active-এ সাবজেক্ট হবে 'All'। বাক্যটি Present Indefinite হওয়ায় 'honour' ভার্ব বসেছে।

question: He is not only a teacher but also a singer. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Besides being a teacher, he is a singer.
options.b: He is a teacher and a singer.
options.c: As he is a teacher, he is a singer.
options.d: He is both a teacher and a singer.

explanation: 'Not only... but also' যুক্ত বাক্যকে Simple করতে 'Besides + being' স্ট্রাকচারটি ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Though we are improving very fast, we have to work hard. (Make it Compound)

options.a: We are improving very fast but we have to work hard.
options.b: We are improving very fast and we have to work hard.
options.c: In spite of improving fast, we work hard.
options.d: We must work hard to improve fast.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে 'Though/Although' থাকলে Compound করার সময় মাঝখানে 'but' বসে।

question: Very few cricket teams in the world are as unpredictable as Pakistan. (Make it Superlative)

options.a: Pakistan is the most unpredictable cricket team in the world.
options.b: Pakistan is one of the most unpredictable cricket teams in the world.
options.c: Pakistan is more unpredictable than most other teams.
options.d: Pakistan is very unpredictable team.

explanation: Positive শুরু 'Very few' দিয়ে হলে Superlative-এ 'one of the + plural noun' বসে।

question: My friend came to me to get help from us. (Make it Complex)

options.a: My friend came to me so that he could get help from us.
options.b: My friend came to me so that he can get help.
options.c: When my friend came, he got help.
options.d: Since my friend came, he got help.

explanation: উদ্দেশ্য (to + verb) বোঝালে Complex-এ 'so that' বসে। বাক্যের প্রথম অংশ Past tense হওয়ায় 'could' বসেছে।

question: Dowry hampers the peace of the society. (Make it Passive)

options.a: The peace of the society is hampered by dowry.
options.b: Peace is hampered by dowry.
options.c: Society is hampered by dowry.
options.d: Dowry is being hampered.

explanation: Object (The peace of the society) + am/is/are + V3 + by + subject।

question: The brutal condition of the dark age must be stopped soon. (Make it Active)

options.a: We must stop the brutal condition of the dark age soon.
options.b: Someone must stop the brutal condition.
options.c: The condition must stop itself.
options.d: Both a and b can be correct.

explanation: Passive-এ 'by' অংশ না থাকলে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ সাবজেক্ট (We/People/Someone) আনতে হয়।

question: This is one of the major problems of Bangladesh. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Very few problems of Bangladesh are as major as this.
options.b: No other problem is as major as this.
options.c: This problem is very major.
options.d: This is as major as other problems.

explanation: 'One of the' থাকলে Positive করার সময় 'Very few' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়।

question: The dowry seekers are very greedy and demand money. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Being very greedy, the dowry seekers demand money.
options.b: The dowry seekers are greedy to demand money.
options.c: Greedy dowry seekers demand money.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Compound থেকে Simple করার সময় Participle (Being) অথবা Adjective (Greedy) সরাসরি ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: What an unworthy crime the dowry is! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: The dowry is a very unworthy crime.
options.b: The dowry is an unworthy crime.
options.c: Dowry is a serious crime.
options.d: It is very unworthy crime.

explanation: Exclamatory থেকে Assertive করার সময় 'What/How' এর পরিবর্তে 'very' বা 'great' বসে এবং সাবজেক্ট শুরুতে আসে।

question: We work hard to attain success in our life. (Make it Complex)

options.a: We work hard so that we can attain success in our life.
options.b: We work hard and attain success.
options.c: If we work hard, we can attain success.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: উদ্দেশ্য বোঝালে 'so that' এবং শর্ত বোঝালে 'if' ব্যবহার করে Complex করা যায়।

question: Peace and prosperity is not possible without being industrious. (Make it Affirmative)

options.a: Peace and prosperity is possible only by being industrious.
options.b: Industrious people are peaceful.
options.c: Peace and prosperity is impossible without industry.
options.d: None of the above.

explanation: Negative থেকে Affirmative করার সময় 'not possible without' এর পরিবর্তে 'possible only by' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

question: A man who leads an idle life, brings misery for his life. (Make it Simple)

options.a: An idle man brings misery for his life.
options.b: Leading an idle life, a man brings misery.
options.c: A man leading an idle life brings misery.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Relative clause (who leads...) কে ভেঙে Adjective বা Participle phrase করলেই বাক্যটি Simple হয়ে যায়।

question: He can never help the people of the society. (Make it Passive)

options.a: The people of the society can never be helped by him.
options.b: People cannot be helped by him.
options.c: The people can never helped by him.
options.d: Society cannot be helped by him.

explanation: Modal 'can' থাকলে Passive-এ 'can be + V3' বসে। বাক্যের নেগেটিভ 'never' বজায় থাকবে।

question: Everybody abhors him. (Make it Negative)

options.a: There is nobody but abhors him.
options.b: Who does not abhor him?
options.c: Nobody abhors him.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: 'Everybody' থাকলে নেগেটিভ করতে 'There is nobody but...' অথবা Interrogative style-এ 'Who does not...' ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: Very few insects are as busy as a bee. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: A bee is busier than most other insects.
options.b: A bee is busier than any other insect.
options.c: A bee is the busiest insect.
options.d: A bee is more busy than others.

explanation: Positive শুরু 'Very few' দিয়ে হলে Comparative-এ 'than most other' বসে।

question: It is known as an industrious creature. (Make it Active)

options.a: We know it as an industrious creature.
options.b: People know it as an industrious creature.
options.c: Everybody knows it as industrious.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Passive বাক্যে 'by' না থাকলে context অনুযায়ী We/People/Everybody সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে আনা যায়।

question: It flies from flower to flower and collects honey. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Flying from flower to flower, it collects honey.
options.b: It flies to flowers to collect honey.
options.c: By flying, it collects honey.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Compound থেকে Simple করার সময় প্রথম ভার্বের সাথে ing যুক্ত করে বা 'to + verb' দিয়ে উদ্দেশ্য বুঝিয়ে করা যায়।

question: It stores honey in the hive. (Make it Passive)

options.a: Honey is stored in the hive by it.
options.b: Honey was stored in the hive.
options.c: Honey is being stored by it.
options.d: In the hive honey is stored.

explanation: Present Indefinite টেন্সে Passive-এর নিয়ম: Object (Honey) + am/is/are + V3 + Extension + by + Subject।

question: In winter, it remains idle but it works hard in spring. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Although it remains idle in winter, it works hard in spring.
options.b: If it remains idle in winter, it works hard in spring.
options.c: As it remains idle in winter, it works hard in spring.
options.d: When it remains idle in winter, it works hard in spring.

explanation: দেখো ছাত্ররা, বাক্যে 'but' থাকলে সেটি বিপরীত অর্থ প্রকাশ করে। Compound বাক্যে 'but' থাকলে Complex করার সময় আমাদের 'Although' বা 'Though' ব্যবহার করতে হয়। তাই অপশন (a)-ই সঠিক।

question: The humanoid robot, Sophia is one of the newest sensations in the ICT world. (Make it positive)

options.a: No other sensation in the ICT world is as new as Sophia.
options.b: Very few sensations in the ICT world are as new as Sophia.
options.c: Sophia is as new as any other sensation.
options.d: Some sensations are as new as Sophia.

explanation: সবাই খেয়াল করো, Superlative ডিগ্রিতে যদি 'one of the' থাকে, তবে Positive করার সময় শুরুতেই 'Very few' বসাতে হয়। আর 'Very few' এর পরে noun-টি সবসময় plural (sensations) হয় এবং verb-টিও plural (are) হয়।

question: Honourable Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina met Sophia at the inaugural ceremony. (Make it Passive)

options.a: Sophia was met by Honourable Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
options.b: Sophia is met by Honourable Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
options.c: Sophia had been met by Honourable Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
options.d: Honourable Prime Minister was met by Sophia.

explanation: এই বাক্যটি Past Indefinite tense-এ আছে। Passive করার নিয়ম হলো: Object (Sophia) + was/were + V3 (met) + by + Subject। যেহেতু সোফিয়া একবচন, তাই 'was' বসেছে।

question: The Hong Kong-based Robotics Company developed Sophia. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It was the Hong Kong-based Robotics Company who developed Sophia.
options.b: Sophia was developed by the company which is Hong Kong-based.
options.c: The company developed Sophia which is Hong Kong-based.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: সিম্পল থেকে কমপ্লেক্স করার সময় আমরা 'It is/was... who/which' স্ট্রাকচার ব্যবহার করে জোর দিতে পারি (Cleft Sentence), আবার Adjective অংশটিকে ক্লজেও রূপান্তর করতে পারি। এখানে (a) এবং (b) দুইভাবেই কমপ্লেক্স করা সম্ভব।

question: The robot generated a great enthusiasm among the youth. (Make it Affirmative to Interrogative)

options.a: Did the robot generate a great enthusiasm?
options.b: Didn't the robot generate a great enthusiasm among the youth?
options.c: Wasn't the robot generating enthusiasm?
options.d: Does the robot generate enthusiasm?

explanation: মনে রাখবে, Affirmative বাক্যকে Interrogative করতে হলে তা Negative-Interrogative করতে হয়। বাক্যটি Past Indefinite হওয়ায় 'Didn't' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হবে এবং ভার্বের base form (generate) বসবে।

question: Bangladesh achieved independence in 1971. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It was 1971 when Bangladesh achieved independence.
options.b: Bangladesh achieved independence and it was 1971.
options.c: The independence was achieved by Bangladesh in 1971.
options.d: When it was 1971, Bangladesh achieved independence.

explanation: সময় নির্দেশক বাক্যকে কমপ্লেক্স করতে 'It was + time + when' স্ট্রাকচারটি ব্যবহার করা সবচেয়ে আদর্শ। এতে বাক্যের অর্থ ও গুরুত্ব ঠিক থাকে।

question: It is the most significant event in the history of Bangladesh. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: It is more significant than any other event in the history of Bangladesh.
options.b: It is more significant than most other events.
options.c: No other event is as significant as it.
options.d: It is very significant event.

explanation: Superlative ডিগ্রিতে যদি শুধু 'the' থাকে (one of the না থাকে), তবে Comparative করার সময় 'than any other' ব্যবহার করতে হয়। ভালো করে লক্ষ্য করো, 'any other' এর পর noun (event) সবসময় Singular হয়।

question: Our Freedom Fighters are the persons who sacrificed their lives. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Our Freedom Fighters sacrificed their lives.
options.b: The persons who are freedom fighters sacrificed lives.
options.c: Sacrificing their lives, they are freedom fighters.
options.d: Being freedom fighters, they sacrificed lives.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে যদি 'Relative Pronoun (who/which/that)' থাকে, তবে Simple করার সময় অপ্রয়োজনীয় ক্লজ মার্কার তুলে দিয়ে সরাসরি মূল ভার্বটি বসিয়ে দিলেই হয়। এতে বাক্যটি ছোট ও সাবলীল হয়।

question: What a great struggle for them it was! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It was a very great struggle for them.
options.b: It was a struggle for them.
options.c: The struggle was great for them.
options.d: It is a very great struggle for them.

explanation: Exclamatory বাক্য 'What a' দিয়ে শুরু হলে Assertive করার সময় 'Subject + verb + a/an + very + Adjective' বসে। এখানে 'great' এর আগে 'very' বসিয়ে এর তীব্রতা বোঝানো হয়েছে।

question: We shall always remember them and it is with pride. (Make it Compound to Simple)

options.a: We shall always remember them with pride.
options.b: Remembering them with pride is our duty.
options.c: We shall remember them and feel pride.
options.d: It is with pride we remember them.

explanation: Compound বাক্যের 'and it is with pride' অংশটি মূলত একটি Adverbial phrase-এর কাজ করছে। Simple করার সময় অপ্রয়োজনীয় অংশ বাদ দিয়ে মূল বাক্যের সাথে 'with pride' যুক্ত করলেই যথেষ্ট।

question: Actually, at that time he was wiser than all. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Actually, no other person at that time was as wise as he.
options.b: Actually, he was very wise.
options.c: Actually, all were as wise as he.
options.d: Actually, no other person was not as wise as he.

explanation: Comparative ডিগ্রিতে 'than all' বা 'than any other' থাকলে Positive করার সময় 'No other' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়। মনে রাখবে, No other এর পরে noun singular হয়।

question: There was another ruler also who was named Queen of Sheba. (Make it Compound)

options.a: There was another ruler and she was named Queen of Sheba.
options.b: Being a ruler, she was named Queen of Sheba.
options.c: Another ruler was named Queen of Sheba.
options.d: She was not only a ruler but also Queen of Sheba.

explanation: Relative clause 'who' যুক্ত বাক্যকে Compound করতে হলে 'who' তুলে দিয়ে এর পরিবর্তে একটি coordinate conjunction (and) এবং সঠিক pronoun (she) বসাতে হয়।

question: One day she thought Solomon's wisdom should be tested. (Make it Active)

options.a: One day she thought that she should test Solomon's wisdom.
options.b: One day she thought to test Solomon's wisdom.
options.c: One day she thought of testing Solomon's wisdom.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Passive বাক্যে 'should be tested' আছে। Active করার সময় সাবজেক্ট (she) এনে 'should test' বা 'to test' ব্যবহার করা যায়। সব অপশনই ব্যাকরণগতভাবে সঠিক।

question: Jim and Della wanted to buy Christmas presents for each other. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Jim and Della wanted to buy Christmas presents and they did accordingly.
options.b: Jim wanted to buy presents and Della also wanted the same.
options.c: They wanted to buy presents so they sacrificed their possessions.
options.d: Jim and Della were couple and wanted to buy presents.

explanation: বোর্ডের প্রশ্নে অনেক সময় মূল বাক্যকে কিছুটা বিস্তারিত করে Compound করতে বলা হয়। এখানে 'wanted to buy' মূল আইডিয়াটি রেখে 'and' দিয়ে যুক্ত করা হয়েছে।

question: A scanty amount of money was saved for this by Della. (Make it Active)

options.a: Della saved a scanty amount of money for this.
options.b: Della has saved a scanty amount of money.
options.c: A scanty amount of money Della saved.
options.d: Della was saving money.

explanation: Passive-এ 'was saved' (Past Indefinite) থাকলে Active-এ ভার্বের past form (saved) হয়। 'by Della' থেকে Della সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে শুরুতে আসবে।

question: Aren't most of the people of our country living in the rural areas? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Most of the people of our country live in the rural areas.
options.b: Most of the people of our country are living in the rural areas.
options.c: Rural areas are where most people live.
options.d: Most people do not live in rural areas.

explanation: Interrogative বাক্যটি Negative থাকলে Assertive করার সময় 'not' উঠে যায়। আর টেন্স (Present Continuous) অপরিবর্তিত রাখতে 'are living' ব্যবহার করতে হবে।

question: They are no less industrious and patriotic. (Make it Positive)

options.a: They are as industrious and patriotic as any.
options.b: They are very industrious and patriotic.
options.c: They are more industrious and patriotic.
options.d: They are not only industrious but also patriotic.

explanation: বাক্যে 'no less... than' বা 'no less' থাকলে Positive করার সময় 'as... as' ব্যবহার করতে হয়। এটি সমতা বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Their motherland is loved profoundly by them. (Make it Active)

options.a: They love their motherland profoundly.
options.b: They loved their motherland profoundly.
options.c: They are loving their motherland.
options.d: The motherland is loved by them.

explanation: Passive-এ 'is loved' থাকলে তা Present Indefinite tense। তাই Active-এ সাবজেক্ট 'They' এর সাথে ভার্বের base form 'love' বসবে।

question: They had a patriotic zeal and, therefore, fought for the country. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Having a patriotic zeal, they fought for the country.
options.b: Because they had patriotic zeal, they fought.
options.c: They fought for the country to show zeal.
options.d: With a patriotic zeal, they fought for the country.

explanation: Compound বাক্যে 'therefore' বা 'and' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'Having + noun' অথবা 'With + noun' ফ্রেজ ব্যবহার করে শুরু করা যায়। অপশন (d) এখানে বেশি মার্জিত।

question: Who denies their contribution to their motherland? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Everybody denies their contribution.
options.b: Nobody denies their contribution to their motherland.
options.c: None denies their contribution.
options.d: Both b and c.

explanation: Interrogative বাক্য 'Who' দিয়ে শুরু হলে এবং সেটি Affirmative অর্থ প্রকাশ করলে Assertive-এ 'Nobody/None/No one' বসে। এখানে (b) এবং (c) উভয়ই সঠিক।

question: The poor farmers do not get loans on easy terms. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Farmers who are poor do not get loans.
options.b: Poor farmers hardly get loans on easy terms.
options.c: It is difficult for poor farmers to get loans on easy terms.
options.d: Getting loans on easy terms is not for poor farmers.

explanation: এখানে মূল বাক্যটি ইতিমধ্যেই Simple ফর্মে আছে (একটি মাত্র Finite verb - do get)। তবে বোর্ড স্ট্যান্ডার্ডে অনেক সময় নেগেটিভ অর্থ ঠিক রেখে 'hardly' (কদাচিৎ) ব্যবহার করে বিকল্প সিম্পল বাক্য চাওয়া হয়।

question: It is a great pity. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: What a pity it is!
options.b: How pity it is!
options.c: What a great pity!
options.d: What pity it is!

explanation: Assertive বাক্যে 'a great' থাকলে Exclamatory করার সময় 'What a' বসে। নিয়মটি হলো: What + a/an + noun + Subject + Verb! তাই (a) সঠিক।

question: Farmers do not get the facilities which are necessary for food production. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Farmers do not get the necessary facilities for food production.
options.b: Farmers do not get facilities necessary for food production.
options.c: Necessary facilities are not got by farmers.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex থেকে Simple করতে 'which are necessary' (Relative clause) অংশটিকে কমিয়ে শুধু 'necessary' (Adjective) হিসেবে noun-এর আগে বা পরে বসানো হয়েছে।

question: Water which is an important vital element of environment is polluted. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Water is an important vital element of environment and it is polluted.
options.b: Water is an element and it is vital.
options.c: Water is polluted because it is important.
options.d: Environment is polluted by water.

explanation: Complex বাক্যের Relative clause অংশটিকে আলাদা করে 'and' দিয়ে যুক্ত করলেই Compound হয়ে যায়। 'Water is... element' একটি অংশ এবং 'it is polluted' অন্য অংশ।

question: Pure water is necessary for us. (Make it Negative)

options.a: Pure water is not unnecessary for us.
options.b: No water is pure for us.
options.c: Impure water is necessary for us.
options.d: Pure water is never unnecessary for us.

explanation: অর্থ ঠিক রেখে Negative করতে হলে Verb-এর পরে 'not' এবং মূল শব্দের বিপরীত শব্দ ব্যবহার করতে হয়। 'Necessary'-এর বিপরীত 'Unnecessary'। তাই (a) সঠিক।

question: Men pollute water by throwing waste in it. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Men throw waste in water and pollute it.
options.b: Men throw waste so water is polluted.
options.c: Water is polluted because men throw waste.
options.d: Men throw waste and water is polluted.

explanation: Simple বাক্যে 'by + gerund' থাকলে Compound করার সময় দুটি কাজকে 'and' দিয়ে যুক্ত করতে হয়। মানুষ ময়লা ফেলে এবং পানি দূষিত করে—এই ধারাবাহিকতা বজায় রাখা হয়েছে।

question: Water is used largely in time of cultivation. (Make it Passive to Active)

options.a: People use water largely in time of cultivation.
options.b: Farmers use water largely in time of cultivation.
options.c: We use water largely in time of cultivation.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: এই Passive বাক্যে কে পানি ব্যবহার করে তা বলা নেই। চাষাবাদের ক্ষেত্রে 'Farmers', 'People' বা 'We' যে কাউকেই সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে আনা যায়। তাই সব অপশনই যুক্তিযুক্ত।

question: Very few elements of all living beings are so important as it. (Make it Positive to Superlative)

options.a: It is the most important element of all living beings.
options.b: It is one of the most important elements of all living beings.
options.c: It is more important than any other element.
options.d: It is the very important element.

explanation: Positive শুরু 'Very few' দিয়ে হলে Superlative-এ 'one of the + plural noun (elements)' বসে। মনে রাখবে, 'one of the' থাকলে noun সবসময় বহুবচন হয়।

question: Child labour is one of the most serious crises of the 21st century. (Make it Positive)

options.a: No other crisis of the 21st century is as serious as child labour.
options.b: Very few crises of the 21st century are as serious as child labour.
options.c: Child labour is more serious than any other crisis.
options.d: Some crises are as serious as child labour.

explanation: আবারও সেই নিয়ম! 'one of the' থাকলে Positive হবে 'Very few' দিয়ে। অপশন (a) ভুল কারণ সেটি 'the + superlative' এর নিয়ম।

question: Only poverty is held responsible for this crisis. (Make it Negative)

options.a: None but poverty is held responsible for this crisis.
options.b: Nothing but poverty is held responsible for this crisis.
options.c: Only poverty is not responsible.
options.d: Poverty is responsible for nothing.

explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'Only' থাকলে এবং তা কোনো বস্তুকে (এখানে দারিদ্র্য বা poverty একটি বিমূর্ত বিষয়/বস্তু) নির্দেশ করলে Negative করতে 'Nothing but' বসে। যদি ব্যক্তিকে বোঝাতো তবে 'None but' হতো।

question: In most poor families, parents send their minor children to work so that they can earn something. (Make it Simple)

options.a: In most poor families, parents send their minor children to work to earn something.
options.b: Parents send children for earning something.
options.c: To earn something, parents send children to work.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে 'so that' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'so that + subject + can/could' অংশটি তুলে দিয়ে 'to + verb' (Infinitive) বসাতে হয়। এটি উদ্দেশ্য বোঝায়।

question: Though these helpless children have to undergo bone-breaking work, they are rewarded with abuses. (Make it Compound)

options.a: These helpless children have to undergo bone-breaking work but they are rewarded with abuses.
options.b: These helpless children work hard and get abuses.
options.c: Despite working hard, they get abuses.
options.d: They work hard so they are rewarded.

explanation: Complex-এ 'Though' থাকলে Compound করার সময় মাঝখানে 'but' বসে। এটি দুটি বিপরীতমুখী অবস্থাকে যুক্ত করে।

question: Cox's Bazar sea beach is the longest sea beach in the world. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It is Cox's Bazar sea beach which is the longest sea beach in the world.
options.b: No other sea beach is as long as Cox's Bazar.
options.c: Cox's Bazar is a sea beach which is the longest.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Simple থেকে Complex করতে 'It is... which' দিয়ে জোর দেওয়া যায় অথবা noun-এর পরে relative clause ব্যবহার করা যায়। অপশন (a) এবং (c) দুইভাবেই সম্ভব।

question: It is called pleasure seeker's paradise. (Make it Active)

options.a: People call it pleasure seeker's paradise.
options.b: We call it pleasure seeker's paradise.
options.c: Everybody calls it pleasure seeker's paradise.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: বাক্যটি Passive-এ আছে এবং কোনো 'by + object' নেই। যখন কোনো সাধারণ সত্য বা মানুষের ধারণা বোঝায়, তখন Active-এ 'People/We/Everybody' সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: The visitors go there for enjoying natural beauties. (Make it Compound)

options.a: The visitors go there and enjoy natural beauties.
options.b: The visitors go there so that they can enjoy.
options.c: Visitors go and they enjoy beauties.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Simple-এ 'for + ing' বা 'to + verb' থাকলে Compound-এ 'and' দিয়ে যুক্ত করা হয়। সাবজেক্ট একই হওয়ায় দ্বিতীয় ক্লজে 'they' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

question: Those who become tired may go to relax there. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Tired people may go to relax there.
options.b: Becoming tired, one may go to relax there.
options.c: People may go to relax there being tired.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Complex থেকে Simple করার সময় Relative clause (Those who...) তুলে দিয়ে সরাসরি Adjective (Tired) বা Participle (Becoming tired) ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: Health is wealth. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It is health which is wealth.
options.b: Health is nothing but wealth.
options.c: Wealth is health.
options.d: If there is health, there is wealth.

explanation: ছোট এবং চিরন্তন সত্য বাক্যকে Complex করতে 'It is + Subject + who/which' স্ট্রাকচারটি সবচেয়ে সহজ ও নির্ভুল।

question: A healthy poor man is happier than a sick moneyed man. (Make it Positive)

options.a: A sick moneyed man is not as happy as a healthy poor man.
options.b: A sick moneyed man is as happy as a healthy poor man.
options.c: No other man is as happy as a healthy poor man.
options.d: A healthy man is very happy.

explanation: Comparative বাক্যটি Affirmative হলে Positive করার সময় বাক্যটি Negative হবে। নিয়ম: ২য় Subject (sick moneyed man) + verb + not + as/so + adj + as + ১ম Subject।

question: He can succeed in life. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Can't he succeed in life?
options.b: Can he succeed in life?
options.c: How can he succeed in life?
options.d: Does he succeed in life?

explanation: Assertive বাক্যটি Affirmative থাকলে Interrogative-এ তা Negative-Interrogative (Can't) করতে হয়।

question: If we realize it, we should try to be emotionally balanced. (Make it Compound)

options.a: We should realize it and try to be emotionally balanced.
options.b: Realize it and be balanced.
options.c: We realize it so we should be balanced.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex-এ 'If' যুক্ত বাক্য যদি উপদেশমূলক হয়, তবে Compound-এ ইমপারেটিভ স্টাইল (Verb দিয়ে শুরু) বা 'and' যুক্ত সাধারণ বাক্য ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: Success never comes automatically. (Make it Affirmative)

options.a: Success always comes with effort.
options.b: Success hardly comes automatically.
options.c: Success comes only through hard work.
options.d: Success comes in a non-automatic way.

explanation: Negative থেকে Affirmative করতে 'never'-এর পরিবর্তে 'always' এবং পরবর্তী শব্দের বিপরীত অর্থবোধক শব্দ ব্যবহার করা হয়। এখানে 'effort' (প্রচেষ্টা) 'automatically'-র বিপরীতে ভাব প্রকাশ করছে।

question: We work hard so that we can attain success. (Make it Simple)

options.a: We work hard to attain success.
options.b: Working hard, we attain success.
options.c: We work hard for attaining success.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: 'so that' তুলে দিয়ে 'to + verb' (Infinitive) অথবা 'for + verb+ing' ব্যবহার করে উদ্দেশ্যমূলক Simple বাক্য তৈরি করা যায়।

question: An idle man brings misery for his life. (Make it Complex)

options.a: A man who is idle brings misery for his life.
options.b: If a man is idle, he brings misery.
options.c: It is an idle man who brings misery.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: সিম্পল বাক্যকে কমপ্লেক্স করতে Relative clause (who is idle), Condition (If a man...), বা Cleft sentence (It is...) তিনভাবেই করা সম্ভব।

question: He can never help the people. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Can he ever help the people?
options.b: Can't he help the people?
options.c: Who can help the people?
options.d: Can he never help the people?

explanation: Assertive বাক্যে 'never' থাকলে Interrogative-এ তা 'ever' হয়ে যায়। 'Can' শুরুতে এসে প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য তৈরি করেছে।

question: Everybody abhors an idle man. (Make it Negative)

options.a: There is nobody but abhors an idle man.
options.b: Nobody likes an idle man.
options.c: Who does not abhor an idle man?
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: 'Everybody' থাকলে 'There is nobody but...', বিপরীত শব্দ ব্যবহার করে (Nobody likes), অথবা Interrogative ফর্মে নেগেটিভ করা যায়।

question: A bee is busier than most other insects. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Very few insects are as busy as a bee.
options.b: No other insect is as busy as a bee.
options.c: A bee is as busy as any other insect.
options.d: Some insects are not so busy as a bee.

explanation: Comparative-এ 'than most other' থাকলে Positive করার সময় শুরুতেই 'Very few' বসাতে হয়। মনে রাখবে 'Very few' এর পর noun বহুবচন হয়।

question: It is known as an industrious creature. (Make it Active)

options.a: We know it as an industrious creature.
options.b: People know it as an industrious creature.
options.c: Everybody knows it as an industrious creature.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: বোর্ডের প্রশ্নে যখন কোনো সাধারণ জ্ঞানের কথা থাকে এবং কর্তা অনুপস্থিত থাকে, তখন 'We/People/Everybody' দিয়ে Active শুরু করা যায়।

question: Honey is stored in the hive by it. (Make it Active)

options.a: It stores honey in the hive.
options.b: It is storing honey in the hive.
options.c: It has stored honey in the hive.
options.d: Honey is in the hive.

explanation: Passive-এ 'is stored' (Present Indefinite) থাকলে Active-এ ভার্বের Present form (stores) হয়। 'by it' থেকে সাবজেক্ট 'It' শুরুতে আসবে।

question: In winter it remains idle, but it works hard in spring. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Though it remains idle in winter, it works hard in spring.
options.b: When it is winter, it is idle.
options.c: As it works hard, it is spring.
options.d: If it remains idle, it works hard.

explanation: Compound-এ 'but' থাকলে Complex-এ 'Though/Although' বসে। এটি দুটি বিপরীত ক্লজের মধ্যে সংযোগ তৈরি করে।

question: It leads a disciplined life. (Make it Negative)

options.a: It does not lead an undisciplined life.
options.b: It leads no undisciplined life.
options.c: Does it lead a disciplined life?
options.d: It never leads a disciplined life.

explanation: অর্থ ঠিক রেখে নেগেটিভ করার চিরচেনা নিয়ম: 'does not' + মূল শব্দের বিপরীত শব্দ (Disciplined -> Undisciplined)।

question: A student who is diligent can make a good result. (Make it Simple)

options.a: A diligent student can make a good result.
options.b: Being diligent, a student makes a good result.
options.c: A student is diligent and makes a good result.
options.d: A student can make a good result by being diligent.

explanation: Complex বাক্যের Relative clause-টি (who is diligent) যদি একটি Adjective-এর কাজ করে, তবে Simple করার সময় ওই Adjective-টিকে সরাসরি Noun-এর আগে বসিয়ে দিলেই বাক্যটি সিম্পল হয়ে যায়।

question: The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful buildings in the world. (Make it Positive)

options.a: No other building in the world is as beautiful as the Taj Mahal.
options.b: Very few buildings in the world are as beautiful as the Taj Mahal.
options.c: The Taj Mahal is more beautiful than most other buildings.
options.d: Many buildings are as beautiful as the Taj Mahal.

explanation: Superlative ডিগ্রিতে 'one of the' থাকলে Positive করার সময় 'Very few' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়। এর ফলে Noun-টি Plural (buildings) এবং Verb-টি Plural (are) হয়।

question: The boy was too small to reach the fruits. (Make it Complex)

options.a: The boy was so small that he could not reach the fruits.
options.b: The boy was very small and could not reach the fruits.
options.c: As the boy was small, he could not reach the fruits.
options.d: The boy was so small that he cannot reach the fruits.

explanation: Simple বাক্যে 'too...to' থাকলে Complex করার সময় 'so...that' স্ট্রাকচার বসে। প্রথম অংশ Past Tense (was) হওয়ায় 'that' এর পরের অংশে 'could not' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

question: We must read books to gain knowledge. (Make it Compound)

options.a: We must read books and gain knowledge.
options.b: We must read books so that we can gain knowledge.
options.c: If we read books, we can gain knowledge.
options.d: We must read books and then we can gain knowledge.

explanation: উদ্দেশ্যমূলক Simple বাক্যকে (to + verb) Compound করতে হলে মাঝখানে 'and' বসিয়ে দুটি স্বাধীন ক্লজ তৈরি করতে হয়। এখানে বই পড়া এবং জ্ঞান অর্জন করা—দুটি বিষয়কে 'and' দিয়ে যুক্ত করা হয়েছে।

question: He was surprised at my behavior. (Make it Active)

options.a: My behavior surprised him.
options.b: My behavior was surprising to him.
options.c: I surprised him by my behavior.
options.d: My behavior had surprised him.

explanation: Passive বাক্যে 'at/with/in' প্রিপজিশন থাকতে পারে। Active করার সময় প্রিপজিশনের পরের অংশটি (my behavior) সাবজেক্ট হয় এবং 'was surprised' যেহেতু Past Indefinite, তাই মূল ভার্বের Past form (surprised) বসে।

question: Only the moon was visible in the sky. (Make it Negative)

options.a: None but the moon was visible in the sky.
options.b: Nothing but the moon was visible in the sky.
options.c: Only the moon was not visible.
options.d: The moon was visible only.

explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'Only' যদি কোনো বস্তুকে নির্দেশ করে, তবে নেগেটিভ করার সময় 'Nothing but' বসে। এখানে 'চাঁদ' বা moon-কে জড়বস্তু হিসেবে ধরা হয়েছে।

question: Books are the best companion for us. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: Books are better than any other companion for us.
options.b: Books are better than most other companions.
options.c: No other companion is as good as books.
options.d: Books are better than some other companions.

explanation: Superlative-এ 'the + best' থাকলে Comparative করার সময় 'better than any other' বসে। মনে রাখবে, 'any other' এর পর noun (companion) সবসময় singular হয়।

question: When it was daylight, I was awakened by the noise. (Make it Simple)

options.a: At daylight, I was awakened by the noise.
options.b: In daylight, the noise awakened me.
options.c: Being daylight, I was awakened.
options.d: The noise awakened me in daylight.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে সময় নির্দেশক 'When it was + time' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'At/In + time' ফ্রেজটি সরাসরি ব্যবহার করলেই হয়।

question: Though he is poor, he is honest. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He is poor and honest.
options.b: He is poor but he is honest.
options.c: Being poor, he is honest.
options.d: He is honest despite his poverty.

explanation: বিপরীতধর্মী দুটি গুণ (দারিদ্র্য ও সততা) 'Though' যুক্ত Complex বাক্যে থাকলে, Compound করার সময় তাদের মাঝে 'but' বসাতে হয়।

question: He is the tallest boy in the class. (Make it Positive)

options.a: No other boy in the class is as tall as he.
options.b: Very few boys in the class are as tall as he.
options.c: He is as tall as any other boy.
options.d: He is very tall in the class.

explanation: Superlative ডিগ্রিতে 'the + tallest' থাকলে Positive করার নিয়ম হলো 'No other' দিয়ে শুরু করা। এতে সবার মধ্যে সর্বোচ্চ তুলনা বজায় থাকে।

question: Cricket is a very exciting game. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: What an exciting game cricket is!
options.b: How exciting game cricket is!
options.c: What exciting game cricket is!
options.d: How exciting cricket is!

explanation: Assertive বাক্যে 'a/an' থাকলে Exclamatory করার সময় 'What a/an' বসে। 'exciting' শব্দটি ভাওয়েল (e) দিয়ে শুরু হওয়ায় 'an' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

question: I know where he lives. (Make it Simple)

options.a: I know his living place.
options.b: I know his address.
options.c: I know his home.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Complex বাক্যের Noun clause (where he lives)-কে Simple করার সময় একটি Noun phrase (his living place/address) দিয়ে প্রতিস্থাপন করা হয়।

question: The flowers are so fresh that they look beautiful. (Make it Simple)

options.a: The flowers are fresh enough to look beautiful.
options.b: Being very fresh, the flowers look beautiful.
options.c: The flowers look beautiful because of freshness.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex বাক্যের 'so...that' অংশটি যদি ইতিবাচক ফল দেয়, তবে Simple-এ 'Adj + enough to' অথবা Present Participle (Being) ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: I have no money to spare. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I have no money which I can spare.
options.b: I have no money that I can spare it.
options.c: I have no money so that I can spare.
options.d: If I had money, I would spare.

explanation: Simple বাক্যে 'Infinitive' (to spare) থাকলে Complex করার সময় একটি Relative clause (which I can spare) ব্যবহার করে সম্প্রসারণ করা হয়।

question: Man is mortal. (Make it Negative)

options.a: Man is not mortal.
options.b: Man is not immortal.
options.c: No man is mortal.
options.d: Man is always mortal.

explanation: চিরন্তন সত্য বাক্যকে নেগেটিভ করার সময় 'not' এবং মূল শব্দের বিপরীত শব্দ ব্যবহার করতে হয়। 'Mortal' (মরণশীল) এর বিপরীত 'Immortal' (অমর)।

question: As he was ill, he could not attend the school. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He was ill and so he could not attend the school.
options.b: Being ill, he could not attend school.
options.c: He was ill but he attended school.
options.d: He was ill, therefore he cannot attend school.

explanation: কারণ দর্শাতে 'As/Since' ব্যবহৃত হলে Compound করার সময় দুটি ক্লজের মাঝে 'and so' বা 'and therefore' বসে।

question: Iron is the most useful metal. (Make it Positive)

options.a: No other metal is as useful as iron.
options.b: Very few metals are as useful as iron.
options.c: Iron is more useful than any other metal.
options.d: Iron is a very useful metal.

explanation: যদি Superlative ডিগ্রিতে 'the + adjective' থাকে, তবে Positive করার সময় 'No other' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Give me some water to drink. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Give me some water which I can drink.
options.b: Give me some water so that I can drink.
options.c: If you give me water, I will drink.
options.d: Give me some water and I will drink.

explanation: Infinitive (to drink) যুক্ত Simple বাক্যকে Complex করতে Relative Pronoun 'which' ব্যবহার করে একটি ক্লজ তৈরি করা হয়েছে।

question: The rose is a very beautiful flower. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Isn't the rose a very beautiful flower?
options.b: Is the rose a beautiful flower?
options.c: The rose is beautiful, isn't it?
options.d: How beautiful the rose is?

explanation: বিবৃতিমূলক (Assertive) বাক্য যদি Affirmative হয়, তবে প্রশ্নবোধক (Interrogative) করার সময় Negative-Interrogative (Isn't) ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: Only the brave deserve the fair. (Make it Negative)

options.a: None but the brave deserve the fair.
options.b: Nothing but the brave deserve the fair.
options.c: Only the brave do not deserve the fair.
options.d: The brave always deserve the fair.

explanation: 'Only' যদি কোনো ব্যক্তিকে (brave বা সাহসী মানুষ) নির্দেশ করে, তবে Negative করার সময় 'None but' বসে।

question: Coming home, I found him ill. (Make it Complex)

options.a: When I came home, I found him ill.
options.b: As I came home, I found him ill.
options.c: After coming home, I found him ill.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple বাক্যে Present Participle (Coming) থাকলে Complex-এ সময় বা কারণ বোঝাতে 'When' বা 'As' ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: A lost moment is lost forever. (Make it Complex)

options.a: A moment which is lost is lost forever.
options.b: If a moment is lost, it is lost forever.
options.c: When a moment is lost, it is gone.
options.d: It is a lost moment which is lost forever.

explanation: এখানে 'lost moment' (Past Participle + Noun) অংশটিকে ভেঙে Relative clause 'moment which is lost' করা হয়েছে।

question: He is not only a good student but also a good player. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Besides being a good student, he is a good player.
options.b: He is a good student and player.
options.c: He is both a student and a player.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: 'Not only... but also' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'Besides + being' স্ট্রাকচারটি সবচেয়ে সঠিক, তবে 'both... and' ব্যবহার করেও ভাব প্রকাশ করা যায়।

question: Shut the door. (Make it Passive)

options.a: Let the door be shut.
options.b: The door should be shut.
options.c: You are told to shut the door.
options.d: Let the door shut.

explanation: ইমপারেটিভ (Imperative) বাক্যকে Passive করার নিয়ম: Let + object + be + V3 (shut-এর তিনটি রূপই এক)।

question: He was very tired and fell asleep. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Being very tired, he fell asleep.
options.b: He fell asleep because of tiredness.
options.c: Being tired he was asleep.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Compound বাক্যকে Simple করতে হলে একটি ক্লজকে ফ্রেজে পরিণত করতে হয়। এখানে 'Being' (Participle) বা 'Because of' (Prepositional phrase) দিয়ে তা করা হয়েছে।

question: Health is better than wealth. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Wealth is not as good as health.
options.b: Wealth is as good as health.
options.c: No other thing is as good as health.
options.d: Health is as good as wealth.

explanation: Comparative থেকে Positive করার সময় যদি দুটি বিষয়ের মধ্যে তুলনা হয়, তবে পরেরটি আগে আসে এবং বাক্যটি Negative হয়ে যায়।

question: He is so weak that he cannot walk. (Make it Simple)

options.a: He is too weak to walk.
options.b: Being weak he cannot walk.
options.c: He is very weak and cannot walk.
options.d: His weakness prevents him from walking.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে 'so...that (negative)' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'too...to' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: The sun having set, we returned home. (Make it Complex)

options.a: When the sun had set, we returned home.
options.b: After the sun set, we returned home.
options.c: As the sun set, we returned home.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Nominative Absolute (The sun having set) থাকলে সময় বা কারণ নির্দেশ করতে 'When/After/As' দিয়ে Complex করা যায়।

question: Without working hard, you cannot succeed. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Work hard or you cannot succeed.
options.b: If you do not work hard, you cannot succeed.
options.c: Work hard and you will succeed.
options.d: You must work hard and succeed.

explanation: Simple বাক্যে 'Without + gerund' থাকলে Compound করার সময় 'Imperative + or' স্ট্রাকচার বসে।

question: Alas! He is undone. (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It is a matter of sorrow that he is undone.
options.b: We are sorry that he is undone.
options.c: He is very undone.
options.d: It is sad that he is undone.

explanation: Exclamatory বাক্যে 'Alas!' থাকলে দুঃখ বোঝাতে 'It is a matter of sorrow that' ব্যবহার করে Assertive করতে হয়।

question: The load is too heavy for me to carry. (Make it Complex)

options.a: The load is so heavy that I cannot carry it.
options.b: The load is so heavy for me that I cannot carry.
options.c: The load is so heavy that it cannot be carried.
options.d: The load is so heavy that I can carry it.

explanation: Simple-এ 'too...for me to' থাকলে Complex-এ 'so...that + I + cannot' বসে। শেষে 'it' যুক্ত করা জরুরি কারণ এখানে load-এর কথা বলা হচ্ছে।

question: A man who is greedy leads a miserable life. (Make it Simple)

options.a: A greedy man leads a miserable life.
options.b: Being greedy, a man leads a miserable life.
options.c: Greedy man leads a life which is miserable.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Relative clause 'who is greedy' তুলে দিয়ে সরাসরি Adjective ব্যবহার করে (a) অথবা Participle ব্যবহার করে (b) উপায়ে সিম্পল করা যায়।

question: Who does not love a rose? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Everybody loves a rose.
options.b: Everyone loves a rose.
options.c: All love a rose.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Interrogative-এ 'Who does not' থাকলে Assertive করার সময় 'Everybody/Everyone/All' বসে।

question: Education is more powerful than any other weapon. (Make it Superlative)

options.a: Education is the most powerful weapon.
options.b: Education is one of the most powerful weapons.
options.c: Education is the very powerful weapon.
options.d: No other weapon is as powerful as education.

explanation: Comparative-এ 'than any other' থাকলে Superlative-এ 'the + superlative degree' বসে।

question: Tell me what your name is. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Tell me your name.
options.b: Tell me the name of yours.
options.c: Tell your name to me.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Complex-এর Noun clause (what your name is)-কে Simple করার সময় সরাসরি Noun (your name) হিসেবে লেখা হয়।

question: By reading more, you can learn more. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Read more and you will learn more.
options.b: Read more or you will learn more.
options.c: If you read more, you will learn more.
options.d: You read more and learn more.

explanation: Simple-এ 'By + gerund' থাকলে Compound-এ 'Imperative + and' স্ট্রাকচার ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: I saw a bird flying. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I saw a bird which was flying.
options.b: I saw that a bird was flying.
options.c: I saw a bird when it was flying.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Object-এর পরে Participle (flying) থাকলে তাকে Relative clause (which was flying) বা সময় নির্দেশক ক্লজ (when it was flying) দিয়ে Complex করা যায়।

question: The tea is too hot to drink. (Make it Passive)

options.a: The tea is too hot to be drunk.
options.b: The tea is too hot being drunk.
options.c: Let the tea be drunk.
options.d: Tea is so hot that it cannot be drunk.

explanation: Infinitive (to drink)-কে Passive করতে হলে 'to be + V3' (to be drunk) স্ট্রাকচার ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: He is as strong as a lion. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: A lion is not stronger than he.
options.b: A lion is stronger than he.
options.c: He is stronger than a lion.
options.d: No other is as strong as a lion.

explanation: Positive-এ 'as...as' থাকলে Comparative করার সময় ২য় সাবজেক্ট (lion) আগে আসে এবং বাক্যটি নেগেটিভ হয়।

question: In spite of his riches, he is unhappy. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Though he is rich, he is unhappy.
options.b: Although he has riches, he is unhappy.
options.c: He is rich but unhappy.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple-এ 'In spite of' থাকলে Complex-এ 'Though/Although' বসে। এখানে riches (Noun) থেকে rich (Adjective) বা 'has riches' (Verb phrase) করা হয়েছে।

question: I have some work to do. (Make it Compound)

options.a: I have some work and I must do it.
options.b: I have some work to be done.
options.c: I have some work which I must do.
options.d: I have some work and do it.

explanation: Simple বাক্যকে Compound করতে 'and' এবং প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী একটি Modal (must/have to) যোগ করে পূর্ণাঙ্গ ক্লজ তৈরি করা হয়েছে।

question: What a nice bird it is! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It is a very nice bird.
options.b: It is a nice bird.
options.c: The bird is very nice.
options.d: What a very nice bird it is.

explanation: Exclamatory থেকে Assertive করার সময় 'What a' উঠে গিয়ে 'a very' বসে এবং সাবজেক্ট শুরুতে আসে।

question: No other city in Bangladesh is as big as Dhaka. (Make it Superlative)

options.a: Dhaka is the biggest city in Bangladesh.
options.b: Dhaka is one of the biggest cities in Bangladesh.
options.c: Dhaka is bigger than any other city.
options.d: Dhaka is the most biggest city.

explanation: Positive-এ 'No other' থাকলে Superlative-এ 'the + superlative degree' বসে।

question: Success depends on hard work. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It is hard work on which success depends.
options.b: Success depends on work which is hard.
options.c: If you work hard, success will depend.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple বাক্যকে জোর দিতে 'It is... which' (a) অথবা Noun-এর পরে Relative clause (b) ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: I forgot his name. (Make it Negative)

options.a: I did not remember his name.
options.b: I could not remember his name.
options.c: I never remember his name.
options.d: I did not forgot his name.

explanation: অর্থ ঠিক রেখে নেগেটিভ করতে 'did not' এবং মূল ভার্ব (forgot) এর বিপরীত শব্দ (remember) ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

question: Having finished the work, he went away. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He finished the work and went away.
options.b: He had finished the work and went away.
options.c: He went away after finishing the work.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Perfect Participle (Having finished) থাকলে Compound-এ দুটি কাজকে 'and' দিয়ে যুক্ত করতে হয়। টেন্সের ধারাবাহিকতা অনুযায়ী (a) বা (b) উভয়ই গ্রহণযোগ্য।

question: Very few metals are as precious as gold. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: Gold is more precious than most other metals.
options.b: Gold is more precious than any other metal.
options.c: Gold is the most precious metal.
options.d: Gold is very precious than other metals.

explanation: Positive শুরু 'Very few' দিয়ে হলে Comparative-এ 'than most other' বসে।

question: Do it. (Make it Negative)

options.a: Don't fail to do it.
options.b: Do not do it.
options.c: You are requested not to do it.
options.d: Never do it.

explanation: ইমপারেটিভ Affirmative-কে Negative করতে অর্থের পরিবর্তন না করে 'Don't fail to...' স্ট্রাকচারটি ব্যবহার করা হয়।

question: If you do not study hard, you will fail. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Without studying hard, you will fail.
options.b: By not studying hard, you will fail.
options.c: Study hard or you will fail.
options.d: To fail, you should not study.

explanation: Complex-এ 'If + negative' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'Without + gerund' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: The scenery is very charming. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: How charming the scenery is!
options.b: What a charming scenery it is!
options.c: How charming is the scenery!
options.d: What charming scenery!

explanation: Assertive বাক্যে 'very' থাকলে এবং 'a/an' না থাকলে 'How' দিয়ে Exclamatory শুরু হয়।

question: He had a very sharp mind. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: What a sharp mind he had!
options.b: How sharp mind he had!
options.c: What sharp mind he had!
options.d: How a sharp mind he had!

explanation: Assertive বাক্যে 'a/an + adjective' থাকলে Exclamatory করার সময় 'What a/an' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়। এরপর Adjective (sharp) + Noun (mind) এবং শেষে Subject + Verb বসে।

question: The writer is not only famous but also wise. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Besides being famous, the writer is wise.
options.b: The writer is famous and wise.
options.c: The writer is both famous and wise.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: 'Not only... but also' থাকলে Simple করার স্ট্যান্ডার্ড নিয়ম হলো 'Besides + being'। তবে সমজাতীয় দুটি গুণ বোঝালে 'both... and' দিয়েও সিম্পল ভাব প্রকাশ করা যায়।

question: A student should be attentive so that he can learn well. (Make it Simple)

options.a: A student should be attentive to learn well.
options.b: An attentive student can learn well.
options.c: By being attentive, a student can learn well.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে 'so that' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'to + verb' (Infinitive) বসানো হয়। আবার 'attentive so that he can' অংশটিকে কমিয়ে 'An attentive student' হিসেবেও লেখা যায়।

question: Corruption is one of the worst evils. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Very few evils are as bad as corruption.
options.b: No other evil is as bad as corruption.
options.c: Corruption is more bad than most other evils.
options.d: Some evils are as bad as corruption.

explanation: Superlative ডিগ্রিতে 'one of the' থাকলে Positive করার সময় 'Very few' বসে। এরপর Noun plural (evils) এবং Verb plural (are) হয়। 'Worst'-এর Positive form হলো 'Bad'।

question: Who can escape his fate? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Nobody can escape his fate.
options.b: Everyone cannot escape his fate.
options.c: None can escape his fate.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Interrogative বাক্যটি 'Who' দিয়ে শুরু হলে এবং সেটি 'না' বোধক উত্তর দাবি করলে Assertive-এ 'Nobody/None/No one' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: I saw a girl who was dancing. (Make it Simple)

options.a: I saw a dancing girl.
options.b: I saw a girl dancing.
options.c: I saw a girl and she was dancing.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex থেকে Simple করতে Relative clause (who was dancing) তুলে দিয়ে তাকে Adjective (dancing girl) অথবা Present Participle (girl dancing) হিসেবে লেখা যায়।

question: If you do not move, you will die. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Move or you will die.
options.b: Do not move and you will die.
options.c: Move and you will live.
options.d: Unless you move, you will die.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে 'If + negative' থাকলে Compound করার সময় 'Imperative + or' স্ট্রাকচারটি ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: He is more intelligent than any other boy. (Make it Superlative)

options.a: He is the most intelligent boy.
options.b: He is one of the most intelligent boys.
options.c: He is the very intelligent boy.
options.d: No other boy is as intelligent as he.

explanation: Comparative-এ 'than any other' থাকলে Superlative করার সময় 'the + superlative' (most intelligent) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: I have no pen to write with. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I have no pen which I can write with.
options.b: I have no pen with that I can write.
options.c: I have no pen so that I cannot write.
options.d: There is no pen which I can write.

explanation: Infinitive (to write with) যুক্ত Simple বাক্যকে Complex করতে Relative Pronoun 'which' ব্যবহার করে একটি পূর্ণাঙ্গ ক্লজ তৈরি করা হয়েছে।

question: Only Allah can help us. (Make it Negative)

options.a: None but Allah can help us.
options.b: Nothing but Allah can help us.
options.c: Only Allah cannot help us.
options.d: Allah always helps us.

explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'Only' যদি স্রষ্টা বা ব্যক্তিকে নির্দেশ করে, তবে Negative করার সময় 'None but' বসে।

question: Though the load was heavy, he carried it. (Make it Simple)

options.a: In spite of the load being heavy, he carried it.
options.b: Despite its heaviness, he carried the load.
options.c: The load was heavy but he carried it.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex-এ 'Though' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'In spite of' অথবা 'Despite' ব্যবহার করতে হয়। এরপর Noun বা Pronoun-এর সাথে 'being' বা 'Possessive + Noun' বসে।

question: People call the lion the king of beasts. (Make it Passive)

options.a: The lion is called the king of beasts by people.
options.b: The king of beasts is called the lion.
options.c: The lion is called king of beasts.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Factitive object (king of beasts) যুক্ত বাক্যকে Passive করার সময় মূল অবজেক্টটি (the lion) সাবজেক্ট হয়। 'by people' অংশটি উহ্য রাখা যায়।

question: He works hard to shine in life. (Make it Complex)

options.a: He works hard so that he can shine in life.
options.b: He works hard and he will shine in life.
options.c: If he works hard, he will shine in life.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: উদ্দেশ্য (to + verb) বোঝালে 'so that' এবং সেই একই ভাব শর্ত হিসেবে 'If' ব্যবহার করে প্রকাশ করা যায়।

question: Water is a liquid substance. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Isn't water a liquid substance?
options.b: Is water a liquid substance?
options.c: Water is a liquid substance, isn't it?
options.d: How liquid substance water is?

explanation: Assertive বাক্যটি ইতিবাচক হলে Interrogative করার সময় তা নেতিবাচক-প্রশ্নবোধক (Isn't) করতে হয়।

question: No other building is as high as it. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: It is higher than any other building.
options.b: It is higher than most other buildings.
options.c: It is higher than some other buildings.
options.d: It is very high than other buildings.

explanation: Positive-এ 'No other' থাকলে Comparative করার সময় 'than any other' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: It is a matter of joy that we have won the game. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: Hurrah! We have won the game.
options.b: Bravo! We have won the game.
options.c: Alas! We have won the game.
options.d: How won we the game!

explanation: আনন্দদায়ক ঘটনা বোঝালে 'It is a matter of joy that' এর পরিবর্তে 'Hurrah!' বসে।

question: We eat to live. (Make it Compound)

options.a: We eat and we live.
options.b: We eat and thus we survive.
options.c: We eat so that we can live.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple থেকে Compound করতে মাঝখানে 'and' বসাতে হয়। দুটি সমজাতীয় কাজ বা উদ্দেশ্যকে এটি যুক্ত করে।

question: I forgot his name. (Make it Negative)

options.a: I did not remember his name.
options.b: I could not remember his name.
options.c: I never remember his name.
options.d: I did not forgot his name.

explanation: অর্থ অপরিবর্তিত রেখে নেগেটিভ করতে বিপরীতার্থক শব্দ 'remember' এবং 'did not' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

question: Having finished the work, he went home. (Make it Complex)

options.a: When he had finished the work, he went home.
options.b: After he finished the work, he went home.
options.c: As he finished the work, he went home.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Perfect Participle (Having finished) থাকলে Complex-এ সময় বা কারণ বোঝাতে 'When/After/As' ক্লজ মার্কার ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: Death is better than dishonour. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Dishonour is not as good as death.
options.b: Dishonour is as good as death.
options.c: No other thing is as good as death.
options.d: Dishonour is worse than death.

explanation: Comparative-এ 'better than' থাকলে Positive করার সময় ২য় সাবজেক্ট (dishonour) আগে আসে এবং বাক্যটি নেগেটিভ হয়ে 'not as good as' বসে।

question: Gold is one of the most precious metals. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: Gold is more precious than most other metals.
options.b: Gold is more precious than any other metal.
options.c: Gold is more precious than all other metals.
options.d: Very few metals are more precious than gold.

explanation: Superlative-এ 'one of the' থাকলে Comparative-এ 'than most other' বসে। এরপর Noun plural (metals) হয়।

question: I know what his father's name is. (Make it Simple)

options.a: I know his father's name.
options.b: I know the name of his father.
options.c: His father's name is known to me.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex-এর Noun clause (what his father's name is)-কে Simple করার সময় সরাসরি Noun phrase হিসেবে লেখা যায়।

question: A wise man is respected by all. (Make it Active)

options.a: All respect a wise man.
options.b: Everybody respects a wise man.
options.c: All respected a wise man.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Passive-এ 'is respected' (Present Indefinite) থাকলে Active-এ সাবজেক্ট 'All' বা 'Everybody' এর সাথে ভার্বের প্রেজেন্ট ফর্ম (respect/respects) বসে।

question: He was so weak that he could not speak a word. (Make it Simple)

options.a: He was too weak to speak a word.
options.b: Being very weak he could not speak.
options.c: He was very weak and did not speak.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex-এ 'so...that (negative)' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'too...to' স্ট্রাকচারটি ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: It is a very beautiful bird. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: What a beautiful bird it is!
options.b: How a beautiful bird it is!
options.c: What beautiful bird it is!
options.d: How beautiful the bird is!

explanation: Assertive-এ 'a/an + adjective' থাকলে 'What a/an' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়। এখানে bird-এর আগে a থাকায় 'What a' বসেছে।

question: The boy went to school and found the gate closed. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Going to school, the boy found the gate closed.
options.b: The boy found the gate closed to go to school.
options.c: The boy went to school to find the gate closed.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Compound থেকে Simple করতে একটি ক্লজকে Participle (a) অথবা Infinitive (c) এ রূপান্তর করা যায়।

question: No other city in the world is as crowded as Tokyo. (Make it Superlative)

options.a: Tokyo is the most crowded city in the world.
options.b: Tokyo is one of the most crowded cities.
options.c: Tokyo is more crowded than any other city.
options.d: Tokyo is a very crowded city.

explanation: Positive-এ 'No other' থাকলে Superlative-এ 'the + superlative degree' বসে।

question: Man is mortal. (Make it Negative)

options.a: Man is not immortal.
options.b: Man is not mortal.
options.c: No man is mortal.
options.d: All men are mortal.

explanation: বিপরীত শব্দ 'immortal' এবং 'not' ব্যবহার করে অর্থ ঠিক রাখা হয়েছে।

question: I have no money to spare. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I have no money which I can spare.
options.b: I have no money that I can spare.
options.c: I have no money so that I cannot spare.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple-এর Infinitive অংশটিকে 'which/that' ক্লজ মার্কার দিয়ে Complex করা হয়েছে।

question: He must work hard or he will fail. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Without working hard, he will fail.
options.b: By working hard, he will fail.
options.c: He must work hard to fail.
options.d: By not working hard, he will fail.

explanation: Compound-এ 'or' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'Without + gerund' স্ট্রাকচার বসে।

question: The sun having set, we returned home. (Make it Compound)

options.a: The sun set and we returned home.
options.b: The sun had set and then we returned home.
options.c: We returned home because the sun set.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Nominative absolute যুক্ত বাক্যকে Compound করতে 'and' দিয়ে দুটি স্বাধীন ক্লজ যুক্ত করা হয়েছে।

question: Health is wealth. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It is health which is wealth.
options.b: Health is that which is wealth.
options.c: Health is what we call wealth.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: ছোট বিবৃতিকে Complex করতে 'It is... which' বা 'Noun + that/which' ব্যবহার করা যায়।

question: What a pity! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It is a great pity.
options.b: It was a great pity.
options.c: It is very pity.
options.d: What pity it is.

explanation: অসম্পূর্ণ Exclamatory বাক্যকে পূর্ণাঙ্গ Assertive করতে 'It is a great' ফ্রেজটি ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Shut the door. (Make it Passive)

options.a: Let the door be shut.
options.b: The door should be shut.
options.c: You are requested to shut the door.
options.d: Let the door shut.

explanation: Imperative বাক্যকে Passive করার সাধারণ নিয়ম: Let + object + be + V3।

question: He is not so brave as you. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: You are braver than he.
options.b: You are more brave than he.
options.c: He is braver than you.
options.d: He is as brave as you.

explanation: Positive নেগেটিভ হলে Comparative-এ ২য় সাবজেক্ট আগে আসে এবং 'braver than' বসে।

question: In spite of his riches, he is unhappy. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He is rich but he is unhappy.
options.b: He has riches but he is unhappy.
options.c: He is rich yet he is unhappy.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Simple-এ 'In spite of' থাকলে Compound-এ 'but' বা 'yet' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Only the graduated are eligible for the post. (Make it Negative)

options.a: None but the graduated are eligible for the post.
options.b: Nothing but the graduated are eligible.
options.c: Only the graduated are not eligible.
options.d: No one but the graduated are eligible.

explanation: ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে 'Only' উঠে গিয়ে 'None but' বসে।

question: He was very tired and fell asleep. (Make it Simple)

options.a: Being very tired, he fell asleep.
options.b: He fell asleep for being tired.
options.c: Because of being tired he fell asleep.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Compound থেকে Simple করতে ক্লজকে Participle বা Prepositional phrase-এ রূপান্তর করা যায়।

question: Cricket is a very exciting game. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Isn't cricket a very exciting game?
options.b: Is cricket a very exciting game?
options.c: Does cricket become exciting game?
options.d: Isn't exciting game cricket?

explanation: Affirmative বাক্যকে Interrogative করতে Negative-Interrogative (Isn't) করা হয়েছে।

question: The Taj Mahal is the most beautiful building in India. (Make it Positive)

options.a: No other building in India is as beautiful as the Taj Mahal.
options.b: Very few buildings in India are as beautiful as the Taj Mahal.
options.c: The Taj Mahal is more beautiful than any other building.
options.d: Any building is beautiful like Taj Mahal.

explanation: Superlative ডিগ্রিতে 'the + adjective' থাকলে Positive-এ 'No other' বসে।

question: I have some work and I must do it. (Make it Simple)

options.a: I have some work to do.
options.b: I have some work to be done.
options.c: Doing some work, I must do it.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Compound-এর 'and + must do it' অংশটিকে Infinitive 'to do' তে রূপান্তর করে সিম্পল করা হয়েছে।

question: Alas! He is undone. (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It is a matter of sorrow that he is undone.
options.b: It is very sad that he is undone.
options.c: I am sorry that he is undone.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: দুঃখজনক পরিস্থিতিতে 'Alas!' তুলে দিয়ে 'It is a matter of sorrow/sad that' বসাতে হয়।

question: Tell me your age. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Tell me how old you are.
options.b: Tell me what your age is.
options.c: Tell me when you were born.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Noun (age) কে Noun clause (how old you are/what your age is) এ রূপান্তর করা হয়েছে।

question: Without working hard, you cannot succeed. (Make it Compound)

options.a: Work hard or you cannot succeed.
options.b: If you do not work hard, you cannot succeed.
options.c: Work hard and you will succeed.
options.d: Study hard and you succeed.

explanation: Simple-এ 'Without + gerund' থাকলে Compound-এ 'Imperative + or' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: As he was ill, he could not go to school. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He was ill and so he could not go to school.
options.b: He was ill and therefore could not go to school.
options.c: Being ill, he did not go to school.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: কারণ দর্শাতে 'As' থাকলে Compound-এ 'and so/and therefore' বসে।

question: Who does not love his country? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Everybody loves his country.
options.b: Everyone loves his country.
options.c: All love their country.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Interrogative-এ 'Who does not' থাকলে Assertive-এ 'Everybody/Everyone' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: I saw a bird flying. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I saw a bird which was flying.
options.b: I saw that a bird was flying.
options.c: I saw a bird when it was flying.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Participle (flying) অংশটিকে Relative clause বা time clause দিয়ে কমপ্লেক্স করা হয়েছে।

question: Health is better than wealth. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Wealth is not as good as health.
options.b: Wealth is not as better as health.
options.c: No other thing is as good as health.
options.d: Wealth is less good than health.

explanation: Comparative-এ 'better than' থাকলে Positive-এ 'not as good as' বসে।

question: I have some work to do. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I have some work which I must do.
options.b: I have some work that I should do.
options.c: I have some work which to do.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Infinitive (to do) কে Relative clause (which/that I must do) এ রূপান্তর করা হয়েছে।

question: What a nice bird it is! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It is a very nice bird.
options.b: It is a nice bird.
options.c: The bird is very nice.
options.d: It was a very nice bird.

explanation: Exclamatory থেকে Assertive করার সময় 'What a' তুলে দিয়ে 'a very' বসাতে হয়।

question: The postmaster was a very fat and jolly man. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: What a fat and jolly man the postmaster was!
options.b: How fat and jolly man the postmaster was!
options.c: What fat and jolly man the postmaster was!
options.d: How a fat and jolly man the postmaster was!

explanation: Assertive বাক্যে 'a/an' থাকলে Exclamatory করার সময় 'What a/an' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়। এরপর Adjective অংশটি বসে এবং সবশেষে Subject + Verb বসে।

question: He was more generous than any other person in the village. (Make it Positive)

options.a: No other person in the village was as generous as he.
options.b: Very few persons in the village were as generous as he.
options.c: He was as generous as any other person.
options.d: He was a very generous person.
