explanation: Comparative ডিগ্রিতে 'than any other' থাকলে Positive করার সময় 'No other' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়। মনে রাখতে হবে, 'No other' এর পর Noun (person) সবসময় Singular হয়।

question: A student must be disciplined to succeed. (Make it Negative)

options.a: A student cannot but be disciplined to succeed.
options.b: A student must not be disciplined.
options.c: No student should be undisciplined.
options.d: A student cannot help be disciplined.

explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'must' থাকলে Negative করার সময় তার পরিবর্তে 'cannot but' অথবা 'cannot help + verb-ing' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

question: Education is the most powerful weapon to change the world. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It is education which is the most powerful weapon to change the world.
options.b: Education is a weapon which is the most powerful.
options.c: Education is a weapon so that it can change the world.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple থেকে Complex করতে 'It is... which' দিয়ে জোর দেওয়া যায় অথবা Noun-এর পর Relative clause ব্যবহার করা যায়। এখানে দুটি অপশনই ব্যাকরণগতভাবে সঠিক।

question: He saw a bird sitting on the tree. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He saw a bird and it was sitting on the tree.
options.b: He saw a bird so it was sitting on the tree.
options.c: He saw a bird which was sitting on the tree.
options.d: A bird was seen sitting on the tree by him.

explanation: Simple বাক্যে Object-এর পর Participle থাকলে Compound করার সময় 'and' দিয়ে দুটি স্বাধীন ক্লজ তৈরি করতে হয়।

question: Though he is wealthy, he is not happy. (Make it Simple)

options.a: In spite of his wealth, he is not happy.
options.b: Despite being wealthy, he is not happy.
options.c: His wealth cannot make him happy.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex বাক্যে 'Though' থাকলে Simple করার সময় 'In spite of' অথবা 'Despite' ব্যবহার করতে হয়। এরপর Noun বা Being + Adjective বসে।

question: Is there anyone who does not want to be successful? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Everyone wants to be successful.
options.b: No one wants to be successful.
options.c: Anyone wants to be successful.
options.d: Success is wanted by all.

explanation: Interrogative বাক্যে 'Is there anyone who... not' থাকলে Assertive করার সময় 'Everyone/Everybody' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

question: Knowledge is as precious as gold. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: Gold is not more precious than knowledge.
options.b: Knowledge is more precious than gold.
options.c: Gold is as precious as knowledge.
options.d: No other thing is more precious than gold.

explanation: Positive Affirmative (as...as) হলে Comparative করার সময় বাক্যটি Negative হবে এবং ২য় Subject আগে আসবে।

question: Without taking physical exercise, you cannot keep fit. (Make it Complex)

options.a: If you do not take physical exercise, you cannot keep fit.
options.b: Unless you take physical exercise, you cannot keep fit.
options.c: If you take exercise, you can keep fit.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple বাক্যে 'Without + gerund' থাকলে Complex-এ 'If... not' অথবা 'Unless' ব্যবহার করে শর্তযুক্ত ক্লজ তৈরি করা হয়।

question: People hate a corrupted man. (Make it Passive)

options.a: A corrupted man is hated by people.
options.b: A corrupted man was hated by people.
options.c: People are hated by a corrupted man.
options.d: A corrupted man is being hated.

explanation: Present Indefinite Tense-এর Passive নিয়ম: Object + am/is/are + V3 + by + Subject। এখানে 'man' একবচন হওয়ায় 'is' বসেছে।

question: He was too honest to accept the bribe. (Make it Complex)

options.a: He was so honest that he could not accept the bribe.
options.b: He was very honest and did not accept bribe.
options.c: He was so honest that he cannot accept the bribe.
options.d: As he was honest, he did not accept bribe.

explanation: Simple-এ 'too...to' থাকলে Complex-এ 'so...that' বসে। যেহেতু মূল বাক্য Past Tense-এ (was), তাই 'that' এর পরের অংশে 'could not' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

question: Smoking is a very bad habit. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: What a bad habit smoking is!
options.b: How bad habit smoking is!
options.c: What bad habit smoking is!
options.d: What a bad habit is smoking!

explanation: Assertive-এ 'a/an' থাকায় 'What a' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে। বাক্যের শেষে Subject (smoking) এবং Verb (is) বসেছে।

question: Only the students can apply for the scholarship. (Make it Negative)

options.a: None but the students can apply for the scholarship.
options.b: Nothing but the students can apply.
options.c: Only students cannot apply.
options.d: No one but the students can apply.

explanation: 'Only' যখন ব্যক্তিকে নির্দেশ করে, তখন নেগেটিভ করতে 'None but' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

question: A computer is one of the greatest inventions of science. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Very few inventions of science are as great as a computer.
options.b: No other invention of science is as great as a computer.
options.c: A computer is greater than any other invention.
options.d: Some inventions are as great as a computer.

explanation: Superlative-এ 'one of the' থাকলে Positive-এ 'Very few' এবং Noun-এর Plural form ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: When the sun rose, the fog disappeared. (Make it Simple)

options.a: The sun having risen, the fog disappeared.
options.b: At the time of sun rising, fog disappeared.
options.c: After the sun rose, the fog disappeared.
options.d: The sun rose so the fog disappeared.

explanation: দুটি ভিন্ন Subject থাকলে 'When' যুক্ত Complex বাক্যকে Simple করতে Nominative Absolute (Sub + having + V3) ব্যবহার করা হয়।

question: He is so weak that he cannot walk. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He is very weak and cannot walk.
options.b: He is very weak and therefore he cannot walk.
options.c: He is weak but he cannot walk.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Complex-এ 'so...that' থাকলে Compound করার সময় মাঝখানে 'and' বা 'and therefore' বসিয়ে দুটি স্বাধীন ক্লজ যুক্ত করতে হয়।

question: Health is wealth. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Isn't health wealth?
options.b: Is health wealth?
options.c: Doesn't health mean wealth?
options.d: Health is wealth, isn't it?

explanation: Assertive Affirmative বাক্যকে Interrogative করতে হলে তাকে Negative-Interrogative (Isn't) করতে হয়।

question: By reading more, you will know more. (Make it Complex)

options.a: If you read more, you will know more.
options.b: As you read more, you know more.
options.c: Unless you read more, you will know more.
options.d: When you read more, you know more.

explanation: Simple-এ 'By + gerund' থাকলে কমপ্লেক্স করার সময় 'If' যুক্ত পজিটিভ কন্ডিশনাল ক্লজ ব্যবহার করা হয়।

question: I have no home to live in. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I have no home which I can live in.
options.b: I have no home that I can live.
options.c: I have no home so that I cannot live.
options.d: There is no home where I can live.

explanation: Infinitive (to live in) অংশটিকে Relative clause (which I can live in) এ রূপান্তর করে কমপ্লেক্স করা হয়েছে।

question: Who does not know the name of Hazrat Muhammad (Sm)? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Everybody knows the name of Hazrat Muhammad (Sm).
options.b: Nobody knows the name of Hazrat Muhammad (Sm).
options.c: Everyone knows the name of Hazrat Muhammad (Sm).
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: Interrogative-এ 'Who does not' থাকলে Assertive করার সময় 'Everybody/Everyone' বসে।

question: The boy was too lazy to finish the work. (Make it Negative)

options.a: The boy was so lazy that he could not finish the work.
options.b: The boy was not active enough to finish the work.
options.c: The boy was not at all industrious to finish the work.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: নেগেটিভ করার সময় 'so...that' স্ট্রাকচার ছাড়াও বিপরীত শব্দ (not active) ব্যবহার করেও ভাব প্রকাশ করা যায়।

question: I know his birthday. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I know when he was born.
options.b: I know the date when he was born.
options.c: I know what his birthday is.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Noun (birthday) কে Noun clause (when/what/date when) এ রূপান্তর করে কমপ্লেক্স করা যায়।

question: Work hard and you will succeed. (Make it Simple)

options.a: By working hard, you will succeed.
options.b: To succeed, you must work hard.
options.c: Working hard leads to success.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Compound থেকে Simple করতে 'By + gerund', Infinitive, বা Present Participle তিনভাবেই করা সম্ভব।

question: He is as strong as a tiger. (Make it Comparative)

options.a: A tiger is not stronger than he.
options.b: A tiger is stronger than he.
options.c: He is stronger than a tiger.
options.d: No other is as strong as he.

explanation: সমজাতীয় তুলনায় Positive Affirmative হলে Comparative Negative হয়।

question: Water is used for various purposes. (Make it Active)

options.a: We use water for various purposes.
options.b: People use water for various purposes.
options.c: Everybody uses water for various purposes.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: যখন Passive-এ এজেন্ট উহ্য থাকে, তখন 'We/People/Everybody' কে সাবজেক্ট হিসেবে আনা যায়।

question: As soon as the teacher entered the class, the students stood up. (Make it Negative)

options.a: No sooner had the teacher entered the class than the students stood up.
options.b: Scarcely had the teacher entered the class when the students stood up.
options.c: Hardly had the teacher entered the class when the students stood up.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: 'As soon as' যুক্ত বাক্যকে নেগেটিভ করতে 'No sooner/Scarcely/Hardly' স্ট্রাকচারগুলো ব্যবহার করা হয়।

question: I saw a blind man begging. (Make it Complex)

options.a: I saw a man who was blind and begging.
options.b: I saw a man who was blind was begging.
options.c: I saw a man begging who was blind.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple-এর Adjective + Noun (blind man) অংশটিকে Relative clause এ রূপান্তর করা হয়েছে।

question: The sun rises in the east. (Make it Interrogative)

options.a: Doesn't the sun rise in the east?
options.b: Does the sun rise in the east?
options.c: Where does the sun rise?
options.d: Does the sun not rises in the east?

explanation: Present Indefinite Tense-এর Affirmative বাক্যকে Interrogative করতে 'Doesn't' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: In spite of being poor, he is honest. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He is poor but he is honest.
options.b: He is poor and he is honest.
options.c: He is poor yet he is honest.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: বিপরীতধর্মী গুণের ক্ষেত্রে Compound বাক্যে 'but' বা 'yet' বসে।

question: What a wonderful scenery it is! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It is a very wonderful scenery.
options.b: It is a wonderful scenery.
options.c: The scenery is very wonderful.
options.d: It was a very wonderful scenery.

explanation: Exclamatory থেকে Assertive করতে 'What a' তুলে দিয়ে 'a very' এবং শেষে Subject + Verb শুরুতে আনা হয়েছে।

question: He is the best policy. (Make it Negative)

options.a: No other policy is as good as he.
options.b: He is not the worst policy.
options.c: None but he is the best policy.
options.d: No other policy is better than he.

explanation: Superlative ডিগ্রিকে নেগেটিভ করার শ্রেষ্ঠ উপায় হলো তাকে Positive (No other...as good as) এ রূপান্তর করা।

question: I have some money to spend. (Make it Compound)

options.a: I have some money and I can spend it.
options.b: I have some money to be spent.
options.c: I have some money which I spend.
options.d: I have some money so I spend it.

explanation: Infinitive (to spend) কে 'and + clause' দিয়ে সম্প্রসারণ করে Compound করা হয়েছে।

question: Who does not like a flower? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Everybody likes a flower.
options.b: Everyone likes a flower.
options.c: Nobody likes a flower.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Interrogative-এ 'Who does not' থাকলে Assertive-এ 'Everybody/Everyone' বসে।

question: The cow is very useful. (Make it Exclamatory)

options.a: How useful the cow is!
options.b: What a useful the cow is!
options.c: How a useful cow is!
options.d: What useful cow is!

explanation: Assertive-এ 'very' এর আগে 'a/an' না থাকলে 'How' দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়।

question: He is both a poet and a dramatist. (Make it Negative)

options.a: He is not only a poet but also a dramatist.
options.b: He is not only a poet and also a dramatist.
options.c: He is not only poet but dramatist too.
options.d: He is neither a poet nor a dramatist.

explanation: Affirmative-এ 'both...and' থাকলে Negative-এ 'not only...but also' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Seeing the police, the thief ran away. (Make it Complex)

options.a: As soon as the thief saw the police, he ran away.
options.b: When the thief saw the police, he ran away.
options.c: As the thief saw the police, he ran away.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: Simple-এ Present Participle (Seeing) থাকলে কমপ্লেক্স করার সময় সময় বা কারণ নির্দেশক ক্লজ (When/As soon as) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Dhaka is more populous than most other cities in the world. (Make it Positive)

options.a: Very few cities in the world are as populous as Dhaka.
options.b: No other city in the world is as populous as Dhaka.
options.c: Dhaka is the most populous city.
options.d: Some cities are as populous as Dhaka.

explanation: Comparative-এ 'than most other' থাকলে Positive-এ 'Very few' এবং Noun-এর Plural form (cities) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: I know what his name is. (Make it Simple)

options.a: I know his name.
options.b: I know the name of him.
options.c: I know his named.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Noun clause (what his name is) কে সরাসরি Noun phrase (his name) এ রূপান্তর করে সিম্পল করা হয়েছে।

question: Please help me. (Make it Passive)

options.a: You are requested to help me.
options.b: Let me be helped.
options.c: Let help be done to me.
options.d: You should help me.

explanation: ইমপারেটিভ বাক্যে 'Please/Kindly' থাকলে Passive করার সময় 'You are requested to' ব্যবহার করা সবচেয়ে আদর্শ।

question: Man is mortal. (Make it Negative)

options.a: Man is not immortal.
options.b: No man is immortal.
options.c: Man is not mortal.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: চিরন্তন সত্যকে নেগেটিভ করতে 'not + বিপরীত শব্দ' (immortal) ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

question: He was too weak to carry the load. (Make it Compound)

options.a: He was very weak and so he could not carry the load.
options.b: He was very weak and therefore he could not carry the load.
options.c: He was very weak but he carried the load.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Simple-এর 'too...to' অংশটিকে Compound করতে 'very...and so/and therefore' স্ট্রাকচার ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: What a great pity! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: It is a very great pity.
options.b: It is a great pity.
options.c: It is so pity.
options.d: The pity is very great.

explanation: অসম্পূর্ণ Exclamatory বাক্য 'What a' দিয়ে থাকলে Assertive করার সময় 'It is a great' ব্যবহৃত হয়। 'great' এর আগে আলাদা করে 'very' দেওয়ার প্রয়োজন নেই কারণ 'great' নিজেই তীব্রতা বোঝাচ্ছে।

question: Health is wealth. (Make it Complex)

options.a: It is health which is wealth.
options.b: Health is what we call wealth.
options.c: That which is health is wealth.
options.d: All of the above.

explanation: সবগুলো অপশনই 'Health is wealth' এর ব্যাকরণগতভাবে সঠিক কমপ্লেক্স রূপ।

question: Who can deny the truth? (Make it Assertive)

options.a: Nobody can deny the truth.
options.b: None can deny the truth.
options.c: Everybody can deny the truth.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Interrogative-এ 'Who' থাকলে এবং তা না-বোধক উত্তর দাবি করলে Assertive-এ 'Nobody/None' বসে।

question: The tea is too hot to drink. (Make it Complex)

options.a: The tea is so hot that one cannot drink it.
options.b: The tea is so hot that it cannot be drunk.
options.c: The tea is so hot that one can drink it.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: 'too...to' এর ক্ষেত্রে সাবজেক্ট 'one' ধরে Active অথবা 'it cannot be drunk' ধরে Passive—উভয়ভাবেই কমপ্লেক্স করা যায়।

question: I saw a bird flying in the sky. (Make it Compound)

options.a: I saw a bird and it was flying in the sky.
options.b: I saw a bird which was flying in the sky.
options.c: A bird was seen flying in the sky by me.
options.d: I saw a bird so it was flying.

explanation: Simple-এর Present Participle অংশটিকে Compound করতে 'and' এবং সঠিক Pronoun + Auxiliary verb ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

question: A bee is busier than any other insect. (Make it Superlative)

options.a: A bee is the busiest insect.
options.b: A bee is the most busiest insect.
options.c: A bee is one of the busiest insects.
options.d: No other insect is as busy as a bee.

explanation: Comparative-এ 'than any other' থাকলে Superlative-এ 'the + superlative degree' (busiest) বসে।

question: Give me some water to drink. (Make it Complex)

options.a: Give me some water which I can drink.
options.b: Give me some water so that I can drink.
options.c: Give me some water which to drink.
options.d: Both a and b.

explanation: Infinitive (to drink) কে Relative clause (which) বা উদ্দেশ্যমূলক ক্লজ (so that) দিয়ে কমপ্লেক্স করা যায়।

question: How beautiful the rose is! (Make it Assertive)

options.a: The rose is very beautiful.
options.b: The rose is a very beautiful.
options.c: It is a very beautiful rose.
options.d: The rose was very beautiful.

explanation: Exclamatory-তে 'How' থাকলে Assertive-এ 'very' বসে এবং Subject + Verb শুরুতে আসে।

question: Only the graduated can apply for the post. (Make it Negative)

options.a: None but the graduated can apply for the post.
options.b: Nothing but the graduated can apply.
options.c: No one but the graduated can apply.
options.d: Both a and c.

explanation: 'Only' দ্বারা ব্যক্তিকে বোঝালে 'None but' বা 'No one but' উভয়ই ব্যবহার করা যায়।
